label: Every actually grounded bearer covers its exports from receipts in the selected ledger
paraphrase: OPEN analyst application bridge. At the selected world, for every actual concretum which has an actual concrete ground, exports in the same ledger total at most receipts. Building this ledger requires a common unit, a warranted accounting boundary and a substantive connection between being grounded and forwarding the selected quantity. A grounded battery can deliver electrical energy without receiving charging energy during discharge. An electrical-energy ledger that omits its opening chemical store can therefore violate the bridge.
